llm_judge_reasons: Both instruction requirements are covered: slide 2 background color check (0.5 credit) and subtitle text color check (0.5 credit).
Expected value FF0000 is correctly derived from trajectory evidence confirming the title color is Red (#FF0000).
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('bg_color') and expected.get('subtitle_color') — the rules dict is passed directly as expected.
Getter correctly targets slide 2 (index 1) for background via slide.background.fill with SOLID type check (int == 1) and fore_color.rgb.
Subtitle detection via text_shapes[1] (second text-containing shape) is a correct assumption for standard LibreOffice Impress slide layouts.
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S + Enter) before evaluation, ensuring getter reads fresh state from the modified pptx.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per sub-goal) is semantically appropriate for this two-requirement task.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: subtitle color extraction only checks run.font.color.rgb. If color is set at paragraph level or inherited from shape/theme, run.font.color.rgb may raise an exception caught silently, returning None. Consider also checking paragraph-level font color as fallback: para.font.color.rgb.

Minor: background fill detection assumes fill.type == 1 (SOLID). If the user sets a gradient or pattern fill accidentally, this returns None. The current solid-only check is acceptable for the task but worth noting.
